drawings.description: à gauche, deux croquis de courbes : un ovale fermé, incliné, portant un point marqué à son extrémité supérieure droite (un petit trait à l'intérieur) ; et une courbe qui monte, forme une boucle et se recoupe en un point marqué, puis continue vers le haut à droite.
drawings.kind: two curves with a marked point (a closed oval; a nodal curve)
drawings.notes: Left: a closed tilted oval, traced through points of his outline, with a full point at its upper right tip and a small tick inside. Right: a curve rising from the lower left to a marked point, making a loop below and to the right of it, coming back through the same point and going on to the upper right; the curve is drawn through the same computed point twice. Nothing struck. The stroke from H^1(X; A) down to « pt singulier » above the sketches belongs to the text and is not drawn. The pencil doubling of the lower side of the oval is reduced to one line. Overlaid 2026-11-12 (Opus 5.5) on a 400 dpi colour render: the closed oval comes to a point at its marked point, which was drawn on a regular ellipse some 2 units inside the tip; the oval is now traced through points of the page; the nodal curve matches. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
